Existing scoped writer preserves trash/current membership and the durable deferred physical deletion queue. This action never physically deletes files or cancels physical queue records. Clearing actual import-status deletion records permits ordinary reimport.

These native ownership boundaries are additional to ordinary Qt modal input blocking, not invented recapture of file eligibility.
